samples.title: Factorise like the examiner marks it
samples.subject: Maths
samples.script: Factorise six x squared minus seven x minus three. Method: multiply a by c - six times minus three, minus eighteen. Find the factor pair of minus eighteen summing to minus seven: minus nine and two. Split the middle term, group in pairs, extract the common binomial. Two x minus three, times three x plus one. That split line earns the method mark; the final brackets earn the answer mark. Distinction habit: expand your answer back in your head before moving on - thirty seconds buys you certainty.
